model.name: Gates must not encode a SNAPSHOT of the product's shape — a snapshot rots when the product changes (symbol-anchor / current-contract fixtures / load-checked-and-run, each stub-must-fail)
model.description: UNIFYING CAUSE: a gate that encodes a SNAPSHOT of the product's shape ROTS whenever the product changes — the gate goes RED (or, worse, silently un-verifying) while the FEATURE is GREEN. Evidence-backed by 5 measured instances across 4 mechanisms (tester, 2026-08-12): (1) UN-LOADABLE import — rc7 threw SyntaxError from a removed import, verified NOTHING, yet its Test read status:pass until a manual audit; (2) synthetic fixture vs a HARDENED contract — rc3 fed a synthetic single-Active sprint, then resolveSprintPin was hardened fail-closed unless the sprint resolves to a real on-disk dir, so the fake stopped qualifying (product got stricter, test became wrong); (3) LINE-PIN drift — r408 hardcoded server.ts slice(1439,1446) and R40.22 churn moved those lines; (4) delegation-contract change — r4010's src-audit asserted the OLD direct-Done write, but OUR OWN C4.3 commit made approveByOwner delegate to statusNext; (5) synthetic fixture vs a CHURNED contract — r309, same class as (2), backing FOUR rows. Fix by-construction (kill the snapshot-encoding generator, NOT repeat the gate-repair — same shape as R37.15/R37.16).
model.tronQuote: > (No direct Tron quote) — PO-directed capture 2026-08-12 from the tester's stale-gate diagnosis (5 instances / 4 mechanisms). Same kill-the-generator doctrine as R37.15/R37.16.

discoverySource.discoveredBy: robbin-tester (5 stale-gate instances across 4 mechanisms: rc7 un-loadable / rc3+r309 synthetic-vs-hardened/churned contract / r408 line-pin drift / r4010 delegation-contract change)
discoverySource.note: Evidence-backed not speculative. The unifying cause (snapshot-rot) is demonstrated by 5 real rows, backing FOUR held rows. r4010's own fix already applies the symbol-anchor AC (dogfooded).

model.crossRefNote: Honesty family (the gate/board must not lie, by construction): R37.13 (no bespoke-scheme ids) + R37.15 (no embedded-derived-field names) + R37.16 (no sibling-credited RIPE) + R37.17 (no snapshot-rot gates) + R40.32 (gates self-assert served==committed). Distinct-intent each; R37.17 unifies the 3 gate-authoring guards under ONE cause (snapshot-rot) — its 3 ACs are facets of that one intent, not separate subsystems (contrast R37.4 C4 which genuinely split).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Gates SYMBOL-ANCHOR only — slice a NAMED fn body / anchor on a declaration — NEVER a line-range slice or hardcoded line number. LINT-ENFORCED: a line-pin in gate code -> RED (r408's server.ts slice(1439,1446) is the offender; r4010's fix already dogfoods symbol-anchoring). STUB-MUST-FAIL: plant a line-pin in a gate -> the lint goes RED, else it certifies nothing.

Fixtures must satisfy the product's CURRENT contract; PREFER REAL artifacts over synthetic. A synthetic fixture that no longer qualifies under a hardened/churned contract (rc3 synthetic single-Active sprint vs resolveSprintPin real-dir fail-closed; r309 same class) is a STALE GATE, not a broken product — the gate must not read pass on a fixture the current product would reject. Where synthetic is unavoidable it MUST be constructed to satisfy the current contract. STUB-MUST-FAIL: feed a fixture that violates the current contract -> the gate catches it (does not silently pass).

★ EVERY gate is LOAD-CHECKED and RUN so an un-loadable or never-run gate CANNOT sit marked-pass — the structural fix for the ENTIRE stale-pass class (rc7: SyntaxError from a removed import verified NOTHING while its Test read status:pass until a manual audit). STUB-MUST-FAIL: plant an un-loadable gate (bad import/syntax) OR a never-run gate -> the load/run check goes RED and its Test cannot read pass.

Each guard AC carries a STUB-MUST-FAIL arm or it certifies nothing (a guard that cannot fail proves nothing) — the meta-bite discipline shared with R37.13/R37.15/R37.16 + R37.3's gate-proves-the-gate-prover.

The guard is EVIDENCE-BACKED by 5 measured instances across 4 mechanisms (rc7 un-loadable / rc3+r309 synthetic-vs-hardened/churned-contract / r408 line-pin drift / r4010 delegation-contract change), backing FOUR held rows — the unifying cause (a snapshot of the product's shape rots when the product changes) is demonstrated, not asserted.
